So even if later refunded, it's still a conversion? The question likely expects using converted column as is. So the analyst's method is fine.

Unacknowledged data problems: They removed QA orders, accounted for refunds note. They ignored -1 sentinel in customer_age, irrelevant. They didn't address possible missing data in converted? No issues. So fine.
